name: Spinner
summary: Indeterminate activity indicator for a wait with no known end.

a11y.apg: none: the practice adopted is role="status" with an accessible name, which the three references that ship a spinner agree on

props.name: size
props.description: Same scale as the icons, so a spinner and a glyph on the same line measure alike.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being waited for. Announced by screen readers.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides it from assistive tech. Use only inside a control that already announces the wait — a Button with `loading` does.
